name: Do I need to hire a separate plumber or electrician for kitchen cabinet installation?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to hire a separate plumber or electrician for kitchen cabinet installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: For kitchen cabinet installation, you might need to coordinate with a plumber or electrician if your project involves relocating sinks, dishwashers, or adding new lighting or outlets. While our team focuses on the cabinet installation itself, these specialized trades are necessary for proper utility hook-ups and code compliance. We can help guide you on when these services are required and can often recommend trusted professionals in areas like Emeryville to ensure all aspects of your kitchen remodel are completed safely and correctly.
acceptedAnswer.description: You may need a separate plumber or electrician if your installation involves relocating utilities or adding new ones.
